samples.summary: The stale-override sweep only runs on setBlockType, but the same exception can go stale via named-style redefinition and block merge/split/paste
samples.evidence: `dropStaleStyleOff` is invoked only from `Doc.setBlockType` (document.ts:540). The design doc's invariant says a boolean `false` is only legitimate while a layer under the run supplies the key truthy. That condition can also change when (a) the named style itself is redefined or reset — `DocStore.updateStyleDefinition` / `resetStyle` (store/store.ts:39-41, memory.ts:107-115, editor.ts:2822/2855), e.g. Heading 6 redefined to non-italic leaves every `italic: false` in those blocks a dead flag; and (b) runs move between blocks of different types — `applyMergeBlocks` / `applySplitBlock` in store/block-helpers.ts and the paste path can carry a Heading-6 run's `italic: false` into a paragraph. Those paths get no sweep, so the #749 hazard the change exists to remove is still reachable through them; the design doc section in docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md states the invariant without noting these gaps.

samples.summary: Unrequested scope: CRDT write semantics changed (no re-assertion of existing attrs) and a separate superscript/subscript tree bug fixed in the same change
samples.evidence: The task's Scope (docs/tasks/active/20260819-docs-inline-style-off-clears-key-todo.md:51-58) lists only Doc.applyInlineStyle/ToCells demotion, block-helpers merge semantics and tests; Non-goals exclude CRDT-level work ('Merging adjacent Yorkie Tree inline nodes'). This hunk additionally (1) stops re-asserting the node's existing attributes on every styleByPath — a concurrency-semantics change to the shared docs CRDT write path that the issue did not ask for and for which docs-collaboration.md / docs-intent-preserving-edits.md were not updated, and (2) fixes a pre-existing, unrelated superscript/subscript cache-vs-tree divergence.
searchedFor: grep design docs for styleByPath semantics

samples.summary: Duplicated merge rule: normalizeInlines and TextEditor.normalizeInlineList are now the same algorithm in two places
samples.evidence: block-helpers.normalizeInlines now applies exactly the structural-inline exclusion that `TextEditor.normalizeInlineList` (view/text-editor.ts:3810-3828) already implements, with its own equality helper (`inlineStylesMatch`, text-editor.ts:3830). The two rules must stay in lock-step by comment rather than by construction; the view copy could have been dropped in favour of the shared helper this change just made equivalent.

samples.summary: dropStaleStyleOff loops store.applyStyle instead of the existing applyStyles batch API the store interface says to prefer
samples.evidence: `DocStore.applyStyles` (packages/docs/src/store/store.ts:82-97) documents: 'Prefer this over looping applyStyle() whenever one user action must write several distinct ranges in one step ... a loop of applyStyle() calls produces one undo unit per call on stores (like YorkieDocStore)'. `dropStaleStyleOff` writes one `store.applyStyle` per stale run, so one block-type change can produce several extra undo units on top of the setBlockType write.

samples.summary: Link-underline exception resolved per slice rather than per run, deliberately leaving dead flags on plain runs beside a link
samples.evidence: `rangeCarriesLink` makes the whole slice keep `underline: false` when any touched run is a link, so plain runs in that slice retain exactly the dead flag the change exists to eliminate. The tradeoff is documented, but splitting the patch per run would uphold the invariant everywhere.

finding.summary: The stale-override sweep only runs on setBlockType, but the same exception can go stale via named-style redefinition and block merge/split/paste
finding.evidence: `dropStaleStyleOff` is invoked only from `Doc.setBlockType` (document.ts:540). The design doc's invariant says a boolean `false` is only legitimate while a layer under the run supplies the key truthy. That condition can also change when (a) the named style itself is redefined or reset — `DocStore.updateStyleDefinition` / `resetStyle` (store/store.ts:39-41, memory.ts:107-115, editor.ts:2822/2855), e.g. Heading 6 redefined to non-italic leaves every `italic: false` in those blocks a dead flag; and (b) runs move between blocks of different types — `applyMergeBlocks` / `applySplitBlock` in store/block-helpers.ts and the paste path can carry a Heading-6 run's `italic: false` into a paragraph. Those paths get no sweep, so the #749 hazard the change exists to remove is still reachable through them; the design doc section in docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md states the invariant without noting these gaps.

verdict.reason: Verified the absence independently. `dropStaleStyleOff` is defined at packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:474 and invoked from exactly one place, document.ts:544 in `setBlockType`; `BOOLEAN_INLINE_STYLE_KEYS` is referenced only at document.ts:441 and 486, so no equivalently-named sweep exists elsewhere. The named-style redefinition/reset path (store/store.ts:39,41 -> store/memory.ts:107-116, entered from view/editor.ts:2822-2858) only rewrites `doc.styles` and calls `rematerializeDocSpacing` (block spacing, model/named-styles.ts:163) — it never re-examines run-level boolean `false` overrides. `applySplitBlock` (store/block-helpers.ts:231-270) copies run styles verbatim while assigning a possibly different `newBlockType` to the trailing block, and `applyMergeBlocks` (store/block-helpers.ts:344-350) concatenates inlines verbatim; neither consults `blockStyleId`/`resolveStyleInline`. No paste-side sanitiser exists (no *paste* module in packages/docs/src; the only boolean-false style logic in src is document.ts and view/paint-layout.ts). This is in the design-fit lane because docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:313-343 asserts the invariant as holding across the docs engine and names `setBlockType` as the only re-normalisation point, while the repo's own lessons doc states the governing rule — "A conditional exception needs a sweep wherever its condition can change" (docs/tasks/active/20260819-docs-inline-style-off-clears-key-lessons.md:39-45). The task's Non-goals (todo.md:60-66) do not exclude these paths, so neither "already-guarded" nor "out-of-scope" is supported. The blocking judgement is arguable (the todo's three Scope checkboxes are themselves satisfied), but the documented invariant and the implementation do diverge and the doc records no caveat, so the finding stays.
